name: fyndr
description: Fyndr — Event photo sharing with face recognition (one-command dev)

scripts.dev: node scripts/clean-ports.js && node scripts/ensure-mongo.js && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('logs',{recursive:true})" && concurrently --names "api,ml,web" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:ml" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --prefix node-server-1 && node node-server-1/dist/server.js
scripts.compose:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
